items.body: Rodrigo De Paul scored Inter Miami's opening goal with a spectacular long-range strike. He then revealed Lionel Messi's iconic number ten jersey beneath his own shirt. This emotional tribute honored his close friend, who was absent from the match. Messi missed the game after the passing of his father, Jorge Messi, at sixty-eight. De Paul's gesture offered a powerful message of support to his grieving friend.

items.title: Palau removed invasive rats; fish biomass jumped 183% in one year
items.body: A new study from Ulong Island in Palau has found the first experimental evidence that restoring seabird populations by removing invasive rats can also help nearby coral reefs recover. Within a year, researchers recorded more seabirds, increased nutrient movement from land to sea and higher fish biomass, showing that island restoration can benefit both terrestrial and marine ecosystems.

items.title: Britain drops reef cubes and shells to revive native oysters
items.body: Engineered concrete cubes are being deployed in Britain's North Sea to restore native oyster populations. These structures provide a stable foundation for oysters and habitat for marine life. The project aims to rebuild a collapsed ecosystem after a significant decline in oyster numbers. Volunteers are actively involved in cleaning and attaching oysters to the reef cubes.

items.title: 4.3-magnitude earthquake jolts Nashik; tremors cause cracks in houses
items.body: Over the weekend, Nashik district experienced a mild earthquake along with aftershocks. Fortunately, district officials confirmed there were no casualties recorded. Although some homes showed small cracks due to the tremors, inspections of nearby dams indicated they remained intact. Residents are encouraged to stay vigilant and refrain from spreading misinformation during this time.

items.title: Basant Meghwal makes history with silver at World Athletics U20 Championships
items.body: In a groundbreaking performance, Basant Kumar Meghwal elevated himself into the record books by winning a silver medal in the men's high jump, reaching a personal best of 2.21 meters. This victory makes him the first Indian high jumper to achieve this honor at the championship. Additionally, Ashish Yadav's silver medal in javelin throw helped boost India's total medal count to two.

items.title: Job listings show Nvidia hiring for a new AI safety team to address ‘AI threats’
items.body: Nvidia is reportedly assembling a dedicated AI safety and security engineering team. This initiative signals a broader effort to address risks associated with autonomous AI agents. The team will evaluate autonomous AI agents before deployment and test their operational limits. They will also develop AI-powered security software to detect and patch code vulnerabilities. This push aligns with Nvidia's public strategy advocating for open-weight AI development.

Overall, the film's worldwide gross has reached an impressive Rs 15.42 crore.

items.title: Michael B. Jordan and Raye spark dating rumours with recent outing
items.body: <![CDATA[Michael B. Jordan and Raye have sparked dating rumors after a recent Los Angeles outing. The two were spotted together at Six Flags Magic Mountain amusement park on August 7. A TikTok video captured the rumored couple boarding a park ride, fueling fan speculation. While neither has confirmed their relationship, fans are eager for details. Jordan's past relationship was with Lori Harvey, and Raye's past rumors were with Lewis Hamilton.

items.title: Kiara on 'Toxic': 'There will be Kiara before and after this'
items.body: <![CDATA[Kiara Advani is optimistic that her next film, Toxic, will represent a pivotal moment in her career. She acknowledges the support from director Geetu Mohandas and co-star Yash, who both believed in her potential. Advani feels that they have helped her transcend her acting limits with the character Nadia. She eagerly awaits the public's response to the film, which she believes will raise the bar for upcoming projects.

items.title: Perez Hilton’s health remains ‘serious but stable’ after self-harm live stream
items.body: <![CDATA[Following a troubling live stream that led to self-harm, Perez Hilton is now hospitalized in Miami, suffering significant blood loss and injuries that necessitate surgery. His family has shared that he is in serious but stable condition, protected by Florida's Baker Act, with communication restricted to immediate family and medical staff. The recovery process is projected to be prolonged for the famous celebrity blogger.

items.title: 'Toxic' actor Nayanthara recalls first meeting Yash
items.body: <![CDATA[Nayanthara graced the launch of the 'Toxic' trailer following a personal invitation from Yash. Despite feeling out of her element at promotional events, she characterized the occasion as unique. Commending Yash's unwavering commitment, she likened his off-screen character to that of Rocky Bhai and noted that he is among the most dedicated actors she's come across. Yash also shared insights regarding the film's prolonged production timeline during the event.

items.title: 'Spider-Man' box office surpasses 'Endgame' in India
items.body: <![CDATA[Tom Holland's Spider-Man: Brand New Day is smashing records at the Indian box office, raking in thirty-one crore rupees on its tenth day. This remarkable feat now places it ahead of Avengers: Endgame in total gross collections. The English version is leading the way, contributing eighteen crore rupees, with the film's net collection in India soaring to three hundred eighty crore rupees.

items.title: Blake Lively shares a rare family photo on her account
items.body: <![CDATA[In a heartwarming social media update, Blake Lively posted family snapshots from a soccer game last month, where she was accompanied by Ryan Reynolds and their four children. This cheerful moment comes amidst the news of a deposition request from Jed Wallace, who is probing Lively's role in an ongoing legal matter. Currently, the actress is embracing family over everything else.

items.title: Meghan Markle poses with Prince Harry in selfie from David Foster’s charity event in Canada
items.body: <![CDATA[Meghan Markle and Prince Harry recently attended a star-studded event in Canada for the David Foster Foundation, dazzling onlookers as they posed on the red carpet. Meghan paid tribute to Princess Diana by donning her exquisite diamond and sapphire earrings. This appearance followed their earlier trip to the UK, where they enjoyed quality time with their little ones on a memorable family adventure.

items.title: Dwayne Johnson talks about ‘Moana’s mixed reviews'
items.body: <![CDATA[Dwayne Johnson recently shared his thoughts on the mixed feedback regarding the live-action Moana movie. He noted that polarized reviews are a common occurrence in the entertainment industry. Johnson stressed the film's mission to showcase Polynesian culture authentically. Additionally, his wife, Lauren Hashian, expressed an optimistic view, highlighting the story's underlying themes of love, family, and resilience that resonate with audiences everywhere.

items.title: New Mahesh Babu stills from 'Varanasi' released on his birthday
items.body: <![CDATA[Filmmaker SS Rajamouli's upcoming film 'Varanasi' has released new stills today. These images showcase Mahesh Babu as Rudhra during the Africa schedule. Priyanka Chopra plays Mandakini, and Prithviraj Sukumaran is the antagonist. The movie's plot involves an archaeologist finding a cosmic artifact to save the world. 'Varanasi' is slated for a worldwide release in April 2027.

items.title: Yash calls Nayanthara 'lady superstar': 'She looks bada**'
items.body: <![CDATA[Yash commended Nayanthara for her exceptional professionalism and poise during the production of 'Toxic.' She reciprocated the praise, describing him as the hardest-working actor she's encountered, highlighting his considerable personal sacrifices over four years for the film. In 'Toxic,' Nayanthara takes on the role of a gangster named Ganga, with the film set to premiere on August 26, 2026.

items.title: 'Lord of the Rings' stars reunite 23 years after the trilogy
items.body: <![CDATA[Original Lord of the Rings actors reunited for a dinner gathering. Sean Astin and Dominic Monaghan shared photos of their enjoyable evening. This reunion occurs as excitement builds for a new prequel film. The upcoming movie, The Hunt for Gollum, is set for a 2027 release. Fans appreciate seeing the hobbit actors remain friends after many years.

items.title: Fans left shocked over John Goodman’s changed appearance
items.body: <![CDATA[John Goodman has taken fans by surprise with a recent photograph showcasing his impressive weight loss. Viewers have reacted positively to his transformed look, expressing their joy at seeing the beloved actor in a healthier state. Goodman credits his striking change to significant lifestyle modifications, particularly cutting out sugar and alcohol, which contributed to a remarkable weight loss of around two hundred pounds.

Notably, viewers are buzzing about the captivating action sequence before the intermission, contributing to a significant spike in box office earnings on the film's second day.

items.title: India 'playing Hasina card', says Bangladesh home minister
items.body: Bangladesh has openly criticized India for allegedly exploiting the Hasina card, which presents a challenge to India's aims of fostering amicable relations with Bangladesh. The home minister emphasized the importance of mutual respect and sovereignty between nations, expressing concerns that Hasina may be colluding with external forces against the current government. India's frequent gestures toward Hasina are deemed unwelcome by some, complicating neighborly ties.

items.title: Kanimozhi slams Vijay’s all-party delimitation meet as ‘political drama’
items.body: Political discord reigns in Tamil Nadu over a significant meeting regarding delimitation. The DMK has labeled the event a theatrical display aimed at diverting public focus, while AIADMK raises doubts about the chief minister's sudden urgency. Additionally, several parties are advocating for constitutional protections in lieu of simple verbal commitments, striving to maintain the current Lok Sabha seat allocations in the state.

items.title: IN-SPACe moves to privatise operations of Rs 986 cr spaceport
items.body: IN-SPACe is actively on the lookout for private partners to operate Isro's new small satellite launch complex located in Tamil Nadu. This innovative facility is expected to streamline small rocket launches and improve operational efficiency. The chosen operator will oversee all functional aspects, while Isro commits to providing technical training and guidelines during a specified duration. The initiative aims to elevate India's capabilities in small satellite launches.

items.title: Iran says deal on Strait of Hormuz is close but not enough to open the waterway
items.body: A significant shipping route agreement is nearing completion between Iran and Oman, which is essential for reviving the strategic Strait of Hormuz. Iran insists on receiving US compensation and an end to hostilities as part of the deal. Meanwhile, the UAE has noted that another ship has been attacked in the strait, highlighting that normal oil trade can only commence once these larger issues are resolved.

items.title: Proposed MDR for UPI transactions will be nominal, says government
items.body: The government has pledged that the upcoming UPI merchant discount rate will be minimal. This fee will be applicable only to certain merchants and transactions that surpass a designated threshold. Importantly, person-to-person UPI payments will remain free for all users. This initiative is designed to enhance the sustainability of India’s digital payment ecosystem and facilitate service expansion into rural and semi-urban regions.

items.title: Captain of turbulence-hit Phuket-Delhi flight may have failed dope test
items.body: During a turbulent flight from Phuket to Delhi, the captain of an Air India aircraft reportedly tested positive for psychoactive substances. The turbulence caused a significant scare, resulting in hospitalization for thirteen passengers and four crew members. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation is conducting a detailed investigation, and the flight crew has been suspended from flying duties as per standard procedures.

items.title: US rejects China’s attempt to enforce new restrictions at Scarborough Reef
items.body: The United States has firmly rejected China's maneuvers at Scarborough Reef, asserting that Beijing's environmental assertions are hindering Filipino fishermen from accessing their traditional fishing grounds. As a staunch ally in the Indo-Pacific, Washington stands in solidarity with the Philippines, highlighting China's contentious approach of using legal claims to assert maritime rights. This reaffirmation underscores US commitment to its allied nation's interests amidst complex maritime disputes.

items.title: Gen Z is a force that can’t be ignored: Dharmendra Pradhan
items.body: Former Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan acknowledged the immense potential of Gen Z, stating that grasping their hopes and dreams is essential for national advancement. He noted that the eagerness of young people surpasses any governmental duties, a point he shared with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who subsequently reached out to the youth. Pradhan maintained that prioritizing the nation's welfare is of utmost importance.

items.title: Latest Arunachal map shows 3 places illegally held by China
items.body: India has finalized its official mapping of the contested frontier areas of Arunachal Pradesh, encompassing crucial sites such as Asaphila and Maja. In response, the People's Liberation Army of China has erected various structures and roadways in these disputed territories. Historical conflicts have marked this sensitive border, and this mapping initiative effectively bolsters India's stance regarding the ongoing territorial dispute.

items.title: Jadeja’s Kuldeep imitation leaves Gambhir in splits - Watch
items.body: Ravindra Jadeja entertained teammates by mimicking Kuldeep Yadav’s bowling action, leaving Gautam Gambhir laughing during India’s Colombo warm-up match. Devdutt Padikkal impressed with an unbeaten 142, boosting his chances for the opening Test. Jadeja scored 63 and Manav Suthar added 41 as India reached 357/6. Rishabh Pant and Dhruv Jurel disappointed, managing just two and one respectively.

items.title: Vance calls PM after US Senate passes 100% tariff bill, discusses boosting ties
items.body: On Saturday, VP JD Vance engaged in a conversation with PM Narendra Modi, reiterating both nations' dedication to strengthen partnerships in vital sectors such as trade, defense, and upcoming technologies. They shared insights on international matters of shared concern, coinciding with the US Senate's approval of a bill focused on Russian oil transactions.

items.title: 'Jana Nayagan' BO Day 17: Vijay's film records 135% jump
items.body: <![CDATA[Thalapathy Vijay's latest venture, 'Jana Nayagan,' has experienced a remarkable surge at the box office, raking in Rs 2.35 crore in India on its seventeenth day. This impressive figure marks a notable improvement from the previous day's revenue. Notably, the Tamil version has been pivotal in driving the movie's domestic success. Overall, the film has surpassed Rs 312 crore globally, showcasing its widespread appeal.

items.title: 'DC' BO day 2: Lokesh Kanagaraj's film jumps 52.3%
items.body: <![CDATA[Lokesh Kanagaraj's acting debut film 'DC' saw a significant box office increase on Saturday. The action film's net collection rose by fifty-two percent from its opening day. Its total India net collection has now reached eleven point one zero crore rupees. Overseas earnings also contributed to the film's growing worldwide gross. The movie follows Devadas protecting a family from police brutality.

items.title: Tara calls 'Toxic' her 'fairytale' and 'dream come true'
items.body: <![CDATA[At the Bengaluru trailer launch for her film Toxic, Tara Sutaria couldn't hold back her emotions. She expressed that this project was a dream realized for the entire team, feeling truly blessed and overwhelmed to be a part of such a remarkable tale. Co-star Yash shared that Tara's involvement led to an expanded role for her. Toxic is set for release on August 26, 2026.

items.title: 'GDN' BO day 2: R. Madhavan's film shows improvement
items.body: <![CDATA[R. Madhavan's period drama, 'GDN', showcased a promising uptick at the box office on its second day, achieving net earnings of Rs 84 lakhs in India on Saturday. This brought its cumulative net collection in India to Rs 1.46 crore across the first two days. The Telugu adaptation of 'GDN' also experienced a slight rise in its earnings, bringing to life the story of the inventive genius G. D. Naidu.
